text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx + 429 spike detected on /v1/generate (prod). error_rate=12.3% over baseline in last 5m. Paging @oncall-sre-miguel. traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abc123

miguel_sre: Oncall Miguel here — looking. What's the scope and recent deploys?

incident-bot: customer-impact: 14 tenants > 5% failed requests. top errors: 429 from api-gateway, 502/503 from model-proxy. recent config change: gateway rate-limit tweak at 1719000300 by sarah_eng.

sarah_eng: Yep that was me — pushed a tightening to per-tenant burst limits ~7m ago. Reverting now.

miguel_sre: Observing a pattern: some upstream 502s precede a flurry of 429s for other tenants. Looks like a cascading retry/backpressure loop.

alex_support: Support: multiple customers reporting timeouts and aborted streams, tickets rising. Notifying account teams for top 3 impacted.

sarah_eng: Rolling back gateway config to previous (gateway-config-v1). Command I'm running:
```
kubectl apply -f /deploy/gateway/gateway-config-v1.yaml --namespace=infra
```

sarah_eng: Quick note — bug in the tweak: burst was set to 50 not 500 (typo).

```yaml
# problematic snippet from deployed config
rate_limits:
  per_tenant:
    burst: 50   # intended 500
    rate: 10r/s
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for gateway-config-v1 -> 3/5 pods updated

deploy-bot: rollout complete -> 5/5 pods updated

miguel_sre: After rollback, error rate dropped to ~3.1% over the last 2m. Continue to monitor for regressions.

infra-bot: Autoscaler for model-proxy scaled up aggressively during the spike and then hit control-plane quota, generating 503s — we've paused autoscale and set a cap to avoid oscillation.

miguel_sre: Mitigation actions taken:
- rollback gateway rate-limit change (done)
- temporarily bump global burst to 1000 for 15m
- disable aggressive client retries via transient header
- enable smaller-model fallback for critical tenants

alex_support: Customer impact summary (so far): tenant-alpha 22% errors, tenant-beta 9%, tenant-gamma 7%. Outreach: initial notification sent to affected customers.

manager_jane: Thanks team. Start handoff at 04:00 UTC. Prepare a blameless postmortem. Owners: incident lead=miguel_sre, postmortem=sarah_eng, customer-comm=alex_support.

miguel_sre: Handoff notes: keep 5xx <1% for 30m before declaring resolved; watch for any new deploys; I'll remain on-call for another 45m.

alex_support: I'll track customer follow-ups and update status page. Draft outage message ready.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Severity: SEV-2. Incident channel: #incident-1719004321

miguel_sre: Quick action items:
- sarah_eng file PR to add safety-checks on rate-limit edits
- infra to add autoscale caps and a circuit-breaker
- support to consolidate impacted customer list and SLAs

manager_jane: :thumbsup: Good containment. Postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT.

sarah_eng: I'll open the PR now and include a small test that prevents burst < 100.

miguel_sre: Closing thread — monitoring window started. :thumbsup:
